services.llmTitle: Language model readiness for command routing

macros.title: Macros
macros.localOnlyCaption: Macros are saved only on this device

feed.emptyDescription: Tap the microphone — try “Open chat”, “Next window”, “Open search”, or “What time is it”
feed.recordingEmpty: Recording is empty. Tap the microphone and speak longer.
feed.recordingTooShort: Recording is too short. Speak for at least 1–2 seconds.

history.title: Command journal
history.subtitle: Last {{count}} commands on this device
history.clearJournalConfirm: Clear the command journal on this device? Replay list will be empty.
history.saveFailed: Could not save on this device

audit.title: Command audit
audit.subtitle: Server log for support — not your device journal
audit.emptyDescription: Commands you run will appear here for support diagnostics.

confirm.clearJournalBody: This removes replay history on this device. The message feed and server audit are not affected.

intro.title: Voice Command Center
intro.body: Control the desktop by voice: apps, windows, spoken replies, search. Six short highlights — use arrows, dots, or Home and End.

toolbar.title: Status and settings
toolbar.body: Badges show speech recognition, routing, and spoken-response readiness. Audit keeps a server log for support; the gear opens language, voice, WebSocket, and Space-bar behavior.

embedded-bar.title: Help here
embedded-bar.body: In the Studio GU Command tab there is no separate header — the tour button is in the top-right of this strip, like other screens.

shortcuts.title: Macros and commands
shortcuts.body: Macros are your multi-step scenarios; they stay on this device. Expand Available commands to see phrases that match reliably.

messages.title: Conversation
messages.body: Your requests, replies, and command results appear here. For a timestamped replay list, use the clock icon in the bottom bar.

controls.title: Recording
controls.body: Center — start and stop recording. Left — mute spoken replies; right — command journal and clear feed. Space hold/toggle is in settings.

gatewayErrors.server500: Server error (500). Check API logs for speech recognition or cache issues.
gatewayErrors.badRequest400: The server rejected the request. Check that the recording is not empty and the microphone is enabled.

responses.help: I can open apps, switch windows (“next window”), open desktop search (“open search”), toggle spoken replies, minimize everything, and work with folders. Try “open marketing”, “mute sound”, or “what time is it”.
responses.greeting_morning: Good morning! I'm your Assistant. How can I help?
responses.greeting_afternoon: Good afternoon! I'm your Assistant. How can I help?
responses.greeting_evening: Good evening! I'm your Assistant. How can I help?
responses.unknown_command: I didn't quite understand. Say “help” to see what I can do.
